8.1. Syntax Errors

Syntax errors, also known as parsing errors, are perhaps the most common kind of complaint you get while you are still learning Python:

>>> while True print('Hello world')
  File "<stdin>", line 1
    while True print('Hello world')

SyntaxError: invalid syntax
